scripts.test: pnpm build && node --import ./scripts/register-cloudflare.mjs --import tsx --test apps/web/src/*.test.ts apps/online/test/*.test.ts packages/core/dist/*.test.js apps/api/dist/*.test.js apps/mcp/dist/*.test.js
scripts.deploy:online: pnpm --filter @statedock/core build && pnpm --filter @statedock/web build && pnpm --filter @statedock/online run deploy:prod
scripts.selfhost:dev: pnpm --filter @statedock/core build && pnpm --filter @statedock/web build && pnpm --filter @statedock/online dev
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm --filter @statedock/core build && pnpm --filter @statedock/web build && pnpm --filter @statedock/online run deploy:dry-run
